utterances.speaker: Opal

utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Sam — I’ll note the screwdriver set, duct tape, and wrench, and I’ll keep an eye out for any neighbors who can help fill the gaps.

utterances.text: Opal: Perfect, thanks, Nell — the school office after pickup works for me. I’ll keep the repair list organized and ready to hand off there.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
